source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes. That is exactly what i am instructing. There is truce between Ossent and Crownsunder while the Veyr invasion is ongoing' directs the armed detachment to suspend its requisition pending verification and cites the truce as reason. Treat as V's in-character statement; existing Ossent/Crownsunder armistice is canonical, but D347 limited-cooperation counterproposal remains unratified/unforwarded and no new bilateral command authority or active general invasion of Ossent/Crownsunder is established by speech. D356~10:14–10:16 P1 Veteran, already successfully intimidated by actual prior total26 vs16/21 and asking for explicit instruction, decides confrontation with apparent titled official and companions risks compromising the operation; orders his four-person detail to withdraw without collecting the station's stores. P4 leaves supplies undisturbed, P2 descends existing perch by its ordinary access without sending signal, P3 leaves wagon barricade; all four regroup east of station and start along eastward trail together toward their own camp/verification route, still visible from station as departing, no arrival or relay report yet. P1 says 'Very well, Viscount. We will take this matter back to the quartermaster.' This is compliance with immediate suspension only, not surrender, confession, proof of genuine authority or promise of permanent cessation. No new roll required because prior successful pressure and explicit instruction resolves the exact pending choice; independent tactical withdrawal rather than forced fight. No enemy casualties, additional troops, attack or spell. One civilian at western refuge visibly watches departing party, then cautiously gestures to V, no testimony or contract offered yet. V/C/F remain at rise, Mara coach/horse custody unchanged. No unchosen pursuit, approach, document seizure, weapon draw, money, food or feature change. Local immediate requisition halted peacefully, stores preserved; evidence gathering and civilian welfare still available, Crown intelligence milestones not yet earned. Fixed roster remains 4 departing, other4 at camp,9 depot,7 command, existing quartermaster/controller. V chooses speak with civilians, follow trail, or other action.
